title: Machine Learning Zoomcamp packages a free path from fundamentals to deployment
friendlyTitle: Machine Learning Zoomcamp is a free practical course
summary: DataTalksClub’s Machine Learning Zoomcamp is a free four-month engineering course covering regression, classification, evaluation, deployment, trees, deep learning, Kubernetes and production-oriented projects. The repository contains lessons, notebooks, homework and an active community-driven curriculum.
friendlySummary: This repository contains lessons and projects that teach machine learning from the basics through deployment. The course is free and designed to run over four months.
whyItMatters: Use the repository as a structured self-study course or as source material for an internal learning group. The progression from model basics to deployment helps learners practise the operational work that short model demos often omit.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Follow it for self-study or work through it with a team. It is useful if you want to learn how to build and deploy models, not only read about them.
